selection_rationale: The page belonged to the same performance and evaluation cluster as the selected test-anxiety page, scored 67/100, and lacked visible dates, dateModified, sources and the 700-word depth gate. It was not covered by an active B013-B021 experiment.

baseline.unknown_policy: Missing exact-query GSC data is not treated as zero or failure.

acceptance_contract: Keep the existing URL and exact canonical
Lead with a cautious answer-first definition without turning the pattern into a diagnosis
Explain trigger, private experience, behavior and short-term/long-term consequences
Distinguish performance anxiety from test anxiety and broader social anxiety
Provide a bounded four-step observation procedure and safe exposure boundary
Show verified NICE, NHS and peer-reviewed sources
Align visible publication/update dates with Article datePublished/dateModified
Align visible sources with Article citation and answer blocks with FAQPage
Add speakable selectors and consent-gated generic CTA markers
Connect the general anxiety guide, test anxiety, social anxiety and avoidance map
